name: reply_of_every_form
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. The provider echoes what it receives.
procedure: 1. Call echo with a Values that sets every required form and every optional one. 2. Call echo with a Values that sets the required forms only. 3. Compare each reply with what was sent.
expected: Each reply holds the sent value by its portable form and exact types, at every depth, over both transports.

name: empty_reply
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. accept returns no value.
expected: The reply is None over both transports.

name: provider_sees_the_context
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1 with no principal; the scope has a timeout of 10 seconds.
expected: The reply names the calling app, says a deadline is present and says an idempotency key is present, over both transports.

name: principal_reaches_the_provider
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1, from a scope whose principal has an issuer, a subject and claims.
expected: The reply holds the principal's issuer, subject and claims as sorted JSON text, over both transports.

name: principal_off_the_allow_list
state: An app of the host that is not on reference.v1's allow-list for a principal; a scope of it holds a principal.
expected: The call fails with permission_denied, with the message that names the app and the contract, over both transports.

name: no_principal_off_the_allow_list
state: The app of the previous case, in a scope with no principal.
expected: The call is served. The reply holds no principal and names the app as the caller, over both transports.

name: call_from_no_app
state: A scope that belongs to no app. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. Call deposit of 1 on a new account. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: The call fails with unauthenticated and the message that says a call is made from a scope that belongs to an app, and is never sent: the total is 0. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: deadline_passed_at_the_caller
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1, in a scope with a timeout of zero. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. Call deposit of 1 on a new account. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: The call fails with timeout and is never sent: the total is 0. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: deadline_passes_at_the_provider
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1, in a scope with a timeout of 0.2 seconds.
procedure: 1. Call stall, which returns only once its deadline has passed.
expected: The call fails with timeout over both transports.

name: no_deadline_reaches_the_provider
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1, in a scope with no timeout.
expected: The provider sees no deadline and refuses with invalid_argument and its own message, over both transports.

name: request_refused_at_the_caller
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. Call deposit with an amount that is text, not an integer, built without validation. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: The caller refuses the request with an error that is not a contract error and never sends it: the total is 0. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: version_not_required
state: The app that provides reference.v1, which does not require it.
expected: The call is a mistake in the calling code, a UsageError, over both transports.

name: error_of_every_kind
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. For each of invalid_argument, unauthenticated, permission_denied, not_found, conflict and the declared kind gone, call refuse with that kind and a message.
expected: The caller receives that kind and message, with no detail for a standard kind and the record Gone, with the message as its reason, for gone, over both transports.

name: reply_of_another_type
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. Call leak, whose provider returns a record of another type.
expected: The call fails with internal over both transports.

name: provider_fails
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. Call boom, whose provider raises an exception of its own.
expected: The call fails with internal, and its message holds nothing of the exception, over both transports.

name: deposits_in_one_scope
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. In one scope call deposit of 5, then deposit of 2, on a new account. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: The replies are totals 5 and 7, and the account holds 7, after each leg. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).
